params.name: output
params.description: Controls the verbosity of the output, possible values are: `minimal`, `verbose`. Defaults to `minimal`.

items.docs: Retrieves status information about all nodes in the cluster. Use the `output` query parameter to control the level of detail.

info.name: Weaviate Get Node Status By Collection

params.name: className
params.description: The name of the collection (class) for which to retrieve node status.

params.name: output
params.description: Controls the verbosity of the output, possible values are: `minimal`, `verbose`. Defaults to `minimal`.

items.docs: Retrieves status information only for the nodes that host shards for the specified collection (`className`). Use the `output` query parameter to control the level of detail.
